columns.name: ORDER_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique identifier for an order. A single order can span multiple rows - one per product/SKU purchased

columns.name: QUANTITY
columns.description: Number of units of this product sold on this order line

columns.name: COST
columns.description: Per-unit cost of goods — what Big Buys paid the merchant to acquire this product. Typically less than PRICE

columns.name: PRICE
columns.description: Per-unit price charged to the customer at time of sale. Typically greater than COST

columns.name: PRODUCT_TYPE
columns.description: Level 1 (broadest) of the product hierarchy. Values: Accessories, Computers, Smart Home, Audio, Gaming, Video, Mobile Devices, Networking. Hierarchy: PRODUCT_TYPE → PRODUCT_FAMILY → PRODUCT_LINE → PRODUCT_NAME

columns.name: STORE_REGION
columns.description: US geographic region of the store. Values: West, Southwest, Midwest, South, Northeast. Hierarchy: STORE_REGION → STORE_STATE → STORE_CITY → STORE_ZIP_CODE

columns.name: CUSTOMER_NAME
columns.description: Display name of the customer. Not guaranteed unique — use CUST_KEY for joining, grouping, or counting distinct customers.
